name: Thin Python data-access module over the 8 tables
done_when: A unit test inserts and reads back one row per table with no raw SQL in calling code

name: Purge Job as a real runnable script
done_when: Running it against a seeded DB with now_override deletes exactly the expired rows and leaves scenario_runs/dispatcher_accounts untouched

name: Synthetic seed-data generator for data/synthetic/
done_when: Running the generator produces N reports all tagged synthetic:true and a check script validates all of them

name: LLM Generate interface (Ollama connection, prompt in, response out)
done_when: A call against a running Ollama instance with llama3.2:3b returns a schema-valid object for one hand-written test prompt

name: Startup hardware capability check
done_when: The check exits cleanly with a clear message before any model load attempt on underspec hardware

name: Hand-rolled output-schema validator + one retry
done_when: Feeding a deliberately malformed JSON string triggers exactly one retry then a defined error

name: FR-DEGRADE-02 fallback chain (smaller model to rules-based to manual)
done_when: Forcing a MODEL_UNAVAILABLE error on the primary model produces a flagged non-LLM proposal via the rules-based path

name: Submit Incident Report (validation + field errors)
done_when: 5 hand-written malformed reports each return the correct named-field error

name: Offline queue + reconnection drain in timestamp order
done_when: Simulating a network-down flag queues 10 reports; flipping it delivers all 10 in timestamp order

name: Duplicate-report detection and merge
done_when: Two reports within 1 block/10 minutes with a matching address merge into one incident record

name: Scenario Reader (Play Scenario interface)
done_when: Replaying one prewritten scenario file produces the exact same ordered sequence of report submissions on two separate runs

name: Classify & Propose for one resource-agent role
done_when: 10 seeded reports each receive a severity tag and a proposal with a confidence score within the target latency

name: Extend Classify & Propose to the remaining three roles
done_when: All four role types independently classify and propose against role-appropriate seeded reports

name: ~60s reasoning timeout + non-LLM fallback trigger
done_when: Artificially delaying a model response past 60s triggers the documented fallback and logs a TIMEOUT error

name: Resource/Unit Registry reserve/release/get_status
done_when: The real (non-spike) registry module passes the same assertions Spike SP-02's script already validated

name: Agent-node heartbeat + 30s not-responding detection
done_when: Stopping a simulated node's heartbeat for 31 seconds flips its status to not_responding and notifies

name: Resolve Negotiation Conflict (severity/richness/reported-first tiebreak)
done_when: 5 hand-crafted conflicting-proposal pairs each resolve to the documented winner

name: Partial-view reconciliation (newer-timestamp-wins)
done_when: Two agents given different-timestamped data for one incident converge on the newer record after reconciliation runs

name: Log Decision (append-only proposal/override log)
done_when: An UPDATE or DELETE against a logged row is rejected by the database layer itself

name: Decide Proposal auto-path + ADR 0006 batch stand-in policy
done_when: The 5 confidence/severity cases from NFR-SEC-02's own worked example each route to the documented outcome

name: Override Assignment (reason-required + follow-up window)
done_when: An override submitted with an empty reason is rejected; one with a reason logs elapsed-time-since-escalation correctly

name: Pending-proposals list view + polling fallback
done_when: A seeded escalated proposal appears in the UI within 10 seconds of being created

name: Approve/modify/reject/override controls (keyboard-only)
done_when: Completing all four actions on one seeded proposal with the mouse unplugged succeeds with visible focus at every step

name: Severity rendered as text alongside color
done_when: Viewing the UI in grayscale all 5 severity levels are still correctly identifiable by text label

name: Dispatcher login/session + role enforcement
done_when: An observer-role session attempting an override is blocked and the attempt is logged

name: Notify Responder + reserved acknowledgment column
done_when: A finalized assignment produces exactly one notification row; the acknowledged_at column exists and accepts a manually-set timestamp

name: Team-size config loader + scenario_runs orchestration
done_when: Launching one batch run with a given team_size_config produces exactly the right number of unit/agent_node rows

name: Five-measure effectiveness score + naive-baseline comparison
done_when: Scoring one completed run produces all five sub-measures plus one combined score and a comparable baseline score from logged data only

name: Disruption injectors (road closure, unit failure, incident surge)
done_when: Injecting each disruption type mid-run visibly changes at least one in-flight proposal or reservation

name: Markdown report template + fill-in script
done_when: Running it against one completed scenario_run produces a report with all five required sections

name: Post-run static image (Matplotlib + synthetic location graph)
done_when: One completed run produces one saved image file showing the final zone/unit state

name: Unit tests on core negotiation logic
done_when: The test suite covers every tiebreak branch and passes in CI

name: Scenario-replay regression test on one fixed scenario
done_when: Running the same scenario twice produces byte-identical scoring output

name: Property/fuzz test: a resource is never double-booked
done_when: A randomized-input fuzz run of 1,000 proposal attempts never produces two live reservations on one unit

name: Structural check on Scenario Reader output
done_when: Feeding 10 malformed scenario texts to the checker correctly rejects all 10 before they reach the simulation

name: README clean-machine test
done_when: A clean clone reaches a running app in under 5 minutes using only the README

name: Automate the secret scan in CI
done_when: A CI run on a commit containing a fake API key fails the build

name: Author 3-5 pre-written demo scenarios
done_when: Each scenario file passes the structural check and produces a non-empty run

name: Record the post-run visualization into a short demo clip
done_when: One scenario's run produces a viewable short clip with no live network dependency at playback time
